security.reason: Advisory is that the golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp package is unmaintained; the advisory has no fixed version. Only golang.org/x/crypto/argon2 is imported (backend/internal/auth). govulncheck v1.8.0 symbol-level source scan of go1.26.9 reports called=false and imported=false for this advisory, and grep finds no x/crypto/openpgp import anywhere under backend/.
security.compensating_control: Reachability evidence re-checked on every dependency-security run (called=false is still a blocker if it ever becomes true); no OpenPGP functionality exists in the product.
security.reviewer: Claude Opus 5.5 (A38 remediation, pending owner sign-off)
security.remediation: Re-check at expiry for a fixed x/crypto release or a vulndb withdrawal; the exception cannot outlive the 90-day window without a new review.
